Name: Subtler Glasses
Author: Rubecula
Description:
The basegame glasses were too goofy for me so I made them more to my tastes. Comes in 4 colors.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. Glasses can be individually disabled/enabled with config.

Mod has been updated by mar1ux to work with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] mod. Fashion Sense-compatible version can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17246]here[/url]﻿.

Manifest.Name: Subtler Glasses
Manifest.Description: Changes opaque glasses on character creation screen to less goofy-looking ones.
Manifest.Author: Rubecula
